FF GAME · EMPIRICAL SEASON LAB

A believable league. Uncertain careers.

Compare a historical NFL position distribution with three generated seasons, then inspect the histories behind individual players. The goal is realistic game outcomes, not predicting real NFL players.

100 is a fixed historical positional benchmark, not a percentile recalculated each year. The index is capped for display; raw PPR is retained. Scores across positions are not equal raw fantasy value.

1. Does the position pool look like an NFL season?

Gray: historical mean and annual range, 2021–2025. Colored: the first three alternative seasons from the same fictional population, including new entrants. Pool distributions are a design constraint; the plots verify that implementation, not independent forecasting skill.

2. Does history change the range of outcomes?

Previous low, middle and high producers should have different next-season distributions. Bars span the 10th–90th percentile; they show variation, not a confidence interval on the mean.

3. Follow an individual career

Three alternative upcoming seasons

These are alternatives from the same history, not consecutive years. No outcomes were selected for appeal.

What this evidence establishes

One-to-one stochastic matching allocates complete historical NFL-sized outcome pools using age, workload style, recent production and participation. Game-level bootstrap variation creates new stat lines. The model avoids unconstrained extrapolation and preserves scarce league opportunities.

Tests cover production budgets, ranked distributions, active zero-production rates, prior-history relationships, seed stability, numerical accounting, privacy fields and data leakage. The 2023–2025 conditional audit was previously inspected and is a reused audit.

Limits and definitions

Histories use 2015–2025 data; population ecology uses the 17-game 2021–2025 era. Scoring is full PPR, four-point passing TDs and -2 interceptions/offensive lost fumbles; no return or two-point bonuses. Injury reports are incomplete and are not a fitted medical durability model. Retirement/absence labels are not inferred from every zero. Full fictional team play-by-play and multi-decade career validation remain outside this player-pool engine.

Rank plots can look correct because population margins are constrained by design. Conditional history checks are therefore separate. The fixed index benchmark was estimated using 2015–2022 seasons, before the audit. A first visible historical year may be left-truncated at 2015.

This report is standalone: images and player data are embedded. No server, external fonts, libraries or network access are required.
